title: Work Contract for issuing tickets and Regulating visitors at Lighthouse stations under Chennai Directorate for the period from 01.09.2024 to 31.03.2025.
summary: Short e-tender for a manpower work contract to issue tickets and regulate visitors at seven tourist lighthouses under the Chennai Directorate from 1 September 2024 to 31 March 2025.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

scope.item: Work contract for issuing tickets and regulating visitors at lighthouse stations, 01.09.2024 to 31.03.2025 (manpower numbers not given in this notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; original EMD by 23/08/2024 15:00. Performance bank guarantee mentioned (forfeiture for false documents) without amount.

eligibility: Firm registered with Central/State Govt. department/undertaking/autonomous body, with registered establishment/office in Tamilnadu/Puducherry
Valid labour licence, PAN, EPF/ESI registration and GST registration

Similar works for Central/State Govt./PSU in last seven years ending 31/03/2024: three works each >= 40% of estimate, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar work = providing manpower/labour/outsourcing contracts
Average annual financial turnover 40% of estimated cost for past three years ending 31/03/2024 (P&L and auditor's report)
Affidavit of not blacklisted; Income Tax returns for last three years; undertaking that bid is unconditional
Employee strength more than 20; key personnel with PF numbers
Declaration of no relatives employed in DGLL or MoPSW; certificate per Section VII; tender acceptance letter per Section IX
notes: Short Bid Notice Inviting e-Tender (Section I); letterhead reads 'Ministry of Shipping'. No file/reference number printed. Bid download and submission 14/08/2024 12:30 to 23/08/2024 15:00; technical bid opening 26/8/2024 10:00. Eligibility list numbering repeats (vii, viii). Hindi text layer garbled; English parallel.
